unprovenItems: getWorkspace: the composed BFF delivery route performs the Workspace identity read, but services/workspace still exposes no WorkspaceProductService implementation, so that route cannot complete end to end yet. Pre-existing gap, not introduced here.
The Console member page does not exist; only the BFF REST surface is implemented. It belongs to W13 basic Console/BFF integration, not W14.

A platform administrator cannot read the customer catalog plan list: the contract types listComputePlans/listStoragePlans as member, and a platform administrator session has no tenant. The administrator catalog page and the contract therefore disagree; recorded as a decision point for the contract owner and not changed here.

OPL_INVITATION_TTL and the Gateway directory identity are new deployment configuration. Instance-owned manifests and profiles were not edited, so a deployment must supply them before adopting this revision; CloudIdentity refuses to start without a positive invitation window.

Tenant onboarding, suspend/reenable, delete/restore, retained-identity migration and Gateway wallet binding remain unimplemented. No production, Candidate, Release, Instance qualification or real Sub2API account was touched.
